facts.overview: A thirteen-year-old French girl deals with moving to a new city and school in Paris, while at the same time her parents are getting a divorce.
facts.title: The Party

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: As home life fractures, how will she carve out her own space among new classmates and the awkward rush of adolescent freedom?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: In Paris, a thirteen-year-old French girl faces the double challenge of settling into a new school and coping with her parents' looming divorce, balancing teen social life with sudden family upheaval.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Warm, funny, and emotional with an easy viewing rhythm that treats adolescent growing pains and family turmoil with gentle honesty.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Claude Pinoteau balances comic charm with heartfelt domestic friction, capturing the bittersweet momentum of growing up amid major household change.
